description: I build React + TypeScript UIs across different product areas using Micro Frontends, with Material UI for a consistent look and feel.
On the backend, I work with ASP.NET Core, PostgreSQL, and Kafka to build APIs that handle real-time data smoothly.
I've created shared React and .NET libraries that cut down repeated work and made the whole team faster — all packaged with Docker.
I work in Agile sprints across multiple repos, keeping CI/CD pipelines healthy so features ship on time.
I built full-stack modules for a 3D car configurator using React, Material UI, .NET Core, and SQL Server.
I created REST APIs to handle vehicle configuration, pricing logic, and real-time updates across multiple parameters.
I designed and optimized database schemas and stored procedures to keep configuration workflows fast and responsive.
I worked closely with cross-functional teams to connect the UI, backend, and data layers into a smooth end-to-end experience.
